noAccess.title: You don't have access to this page
noAccess.description: You're signed in, but this page belongs to another account or hasn't been shared with you.
reasons: The page was created by a different user or organization.
The link or page id is wrong, or the page was deleted.
Your role or plan doesn't include editing this page.

publicPage.title: This page isn't available to you
publicPage.description: The page you tried to open isn't public. It may be unpublished, private or no longer exist.
reasons: The page has not been published yet, or was taken down.
The link is wrong or out of date.
The event it belongs to is private or closed.

signIn.title: Your session has ended
signIn.description: Sign in again to keep working on this page. Your saved changes are safe.
reasons: You were signed out because the session expired.
You signed out in another tab or window.
Your browser blocked the cookie that keeps you signed in.

notFound.title: We can't find this page
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.
reasons: The link or page id has a typo.
The page was deleted or moved to another event.
You opened a link from an older version of the app.

notFoundPublic.title: This page doesn't exist
notFoundPublic.description: We couldn't find the page you tried to open. It may have been removed or the link may be wrong.
reasons: The link is wrong or out of date.
The page was unpublished or deleted.
The event it belongs to no longer exists.

tooManyRequests.title: Too many requests
tooManyRequests.description: We received a lot of requests from you in a short time. Wait a moment and try again. Your work is safe.
reasons: Many pages or tabs were loading or saving at the same time.
A script or extension kept refreshing the page.
The service is busy and is limiting requests for a short while.

serverError.title: Our server ran into a problem
serverError.description: This is on our side, not yours. Try again in a moment. Your saved changes are safe.
reasons: The server had an unexpected error or is being updated.
A service this page depends on is not answering.
It is usually short. If it stays, contact support.

navbar.saveBeforePreview: You have unsaved changes. Save them before opening Preview.
navbar.savedToLocalStorageOnly: Saved to local storage only (server sync failed)
